rules.filter: the six topic rules (typescript/consistent-type-imports, typescript/consistent-type-exports, typescript/no-import-type-side-effects, import/consistent-type-specifier-style, import/no-duplicates, no-duplicate-imports), plus for C node/global-require and unicorn/prefer-module, and any other diagnostic that isn't among the prepared project's own (rule and message, file by file, as diff.ts matches them), in the handoff and in every re-lint: a project that lints clean apart from these rules. A deviation from a real project, where Ultracite would hand over the subject's other diagnostics too. `verifyRemainingTopicRulesOnly` records what a filter keeping the subject's rules alone would have handed back.
rules.retryLoop: index.ts attemptFileFix: after each attempt, verify (the Oxlint pass on the file, in place, then the filter) and, while diagnostics remain that the agent didn't list on a `Left for review:` line and it didn't time out, another attempt with buildRetryPrompt, up to MAX_AGENT_ATTEMPTS; each attempt under AGENT_TIMEOUT_MS.
